$comment: Long highlights video (D406, user 2026-11-20 interview): one horizontal (16:9) video per recorded session from its H recording, the session's best moments (kill groups, streaks, won matches) in time order, overlapping windows merged once (no footage twice), a short transition between moments, about 8-20 minutes. Too long: the lowest-scored moments are dropped first. Too short for minSec: no video, with the reason in plain words. Read by services/clip/long_video.py. Behind the flag long-highlights-video (on by default, user-requested).
approved: user 2026-11-20 chose the content, the 8-20 minute length, time order, merging and posting as a normal YouTube video; padSec, the scores and batchPieces are the agent's proposal

teaching.$comment: LV1a (D421): word-by-word captions and numbered chapter cards on the long video, read by services/clip/long_teaching.py. Flag long-video-teaching (on by default, user-requested). The speech to text and caption font are the reel captions' (data/clip/reel-captions.json and its preset); these sizes are for the 1920x1080 frame. Chapter animation stays under the overlay rule (enter under 600 ms, leave under 400 ms). Sizes and timings are the agent's proposal, tunable here.

callouts.$comment: LV1b (D422): a little after each medal, the kill feed (the game pack's detector M5, region killfeed, verified regions only) cropped from the picture, enlarged by scale, framed in an accent border with a darker halo; at = the card's top centre (fractions of the frame), kept inside safe. It pops in and out (0 ms). The MP kill feed region is used for every moment: on a BR moment it shows the wrong area (UNVERIFIED on real footage). Values are the agent's proposal, tunable here.

paths.$comment: LV1c (D423): the enemy's movement path before the last kill of a moment, from its red name tag (the game's moments.json enemyTag), drawn on in the accent colour in step with the action, held holdSec and faded out in fadeMs (under 400 ms). Tracked back from the kill for trackSec at fps and trackWidth px wide; drawn only when confident (minPoints points, ends minTravel of the width apart). startRadius / maxJump: shares of the width. Values are the agent's proposal, tunable here; tracking accuracy UNVERIFIED on real footage.
